summary: Milestone's original motorcycle racing series, focused on licensed production bikes, customization, road and circuit events, and increasingly modern simulation and weather systems.

entries.title: Ride

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version as primary; emulate console versions only for preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original console fidelity

primary.why: Ride released on Windows, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox 360, and Xbox One. It includes licensed manufacturers, bike customization, fifteen locations, offline split-screen, and online play up to 12 players; Windows/Steam is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC/Steam version at the highest stable settings; use PS4 or Xbox One only as console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.

primary.why: Ride 4 released on Windows/Steam, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Amazon Luna. It includes hundreds of bikes, detailed riding gear, dynamic weather, a full day/night cycle, A.N.N.A. neural AI, and online play up to 12 players; Windows/Steam is the highest-fidelity configurable route.

primary.why: Ride 5 released on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store. It includes ninth-generation focus, dynamic weather and sky, career mode, endurance race saves and rewind, editors, cross-play lobbies, local split-screen, and online play up to 12 players; PC is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version from Steam or Epic Games Store at the highest stable settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives.

entries.title: Ride 6
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with current patches

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings with current patches.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Ride 6 released on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store. It includes full crossplay, Unreal Engine 5.6, real-world riding legends, Ride Fest, the series' first off-road racing, the most complete garage in Ride history, editors, global online racing, and current patches; PC is the highest-fidelity configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version from Steam or Epic Games Store at the highest stable settings with current patches; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Post-launch bike packs are active; install owned DLC and patches when preserving the complete current version.
